methodology.targetBaseline: existing stored TGT1 premium (card.tgt1), re-played with the same card expiry, fixed SL, and captured LTP close timeline
methodology.wallTarget: selectWallTarget shared policy, p85 favorable-move cap; selected premium snapped to ₹0.05 before replay
methodology.noTrade: No wall target is counted separately; projected no-trade applies the S2 fallback rule and counts only when the existing fallback TGT1 also fails min R:R.
methodology.netR: target reward / (entry - unchanged SL); SL = -1R; a fully covered open trade is marked to its last captured close
methodology.holdWindow: card.at through holdTill inclusive; an event resolves its outcome, otherwise every expected business session must have full-session capture
methodology.fullSessionDefinition: first observed capture at or before 09:30 IST and last at or after 15:30 IST
methodology.archives: gzip minutes streamed one snapshot at a time; only matching card-contract closes are retained
methodology.contractRows: journal.mjs rowFor rule copied verbatim: matching series.next.e selects next.r, otherwise series.r
methodology.censored: partial session or missing hold-window date never enters the headline; report separately as provisional/censored
methodology.reachPercentile: interpolated percentile implied by existing entry-time moveStats reachRate for each candidate spot level

headline.description: Only cards from sessions whose captures span the full day, with paired resolved outcomes; censored multi-day windows and partial session files are excluded.
